must_fix_before_hardware.title: Make physical-placement controls complete and fatal
must_fix_before_hardware.finding: BlockReplay.compare asserts only sha256, shape, dtype and partition_spec, then sets common_actual_fp32_operands_masters_and_physical_specs_exact true. It does not compare recorded memory_kind, concrete device_set, or local shard indices/shapes. Controller omits stage physical metadata and source physical metadata from its cross-child invariants; provenance source_operands omits complete physical signatures. PartitionSpec alone cannot prove the same physical mapping. Raw helper cross-child records do compare physical metadata, but this does not cover the full source/stage boundary path.
must_fix_before_hardware.current_evidence: CPU named/native argument/cotangent physical signatures were independently inspected and agree for all four stages; no current placement drift demonstrated.
must_fix_before_hardware.required_change: In a new revision, record and assert complete shape/dtype/spec/memory/device/shard signatures for source/common/stage arguments and cotangents, and their A/B invariants. Permit only the explicitly intended Auto versus Explicit axis-type difference. Fail before attribution on any unexpected mapping. Do not mutate the frozen bundle.

must_fix_before_hardware.title: Make cross-child invariant failure fatal to the controller
must_fix_before_hardware.finding: A failed cross_child_guards invariant only sets summary passed/scientific_attribution_valid false. After writing the summary the controller returns success and prints completed:true. This misses the requested fatal non-small A/B identity contract even though the JSON does not falsely claim attribution. For example a candidate native forward drift can leave each child internally valid yet only fail the cross-child native_forward_unchanged guard.
must_fix_before_hardware.current_evidence: All sixteen existing CPU cross-child guards pass, so this path was not exercised by the proof.
must_fix_before_hardware.required_change: Preserve the full failure summary, then raise/exit nonzero when any required cross-child invariant fails in non-small numerical mode. Keep mechanics/abstract mode labels explicit. Locally verify rejection with synthetic changed guard/placement metadata, then freeze a new manifest and archive the delta.

causal_limits: The standalone raw kernel is source-derived and uses actual FP32 source-derived operands, but materializing Q, context, trig and cotangents changes compilation context. Exact standalone kernel forward equality is mandatory; it is not established on CPU and unknown on TPU.
The shared incoming cotangent comes from the named source suffix/tail at the fixed source boundary. It is not an independently native or uninstrumented full Trainer hidden cotangent.

Downstream arrays are QKV projection plus inputnorm contributions, not whole-prefix/full-model gradients. Holding omitted contributions common isolates an order differential but does not reconstruct every absolute gradient.

A nonzero order difference proves sensitivity to these rounding orders on this materialized buffer. It does not prove baseline native equals coefficient-first or candidate equals scale-first inside the actual compiled block, nor sufficient cause of a loss trajectory.

Candidate barrier counts in abstract JAX graphs are construction evidence. Candidate actual optimized TPU HLO and the scaled-dQ boundary still require inspection; HLO alone does not establish every device floating-point instruction.

Controller scientific_attribution_valid is a validity flag, not a numerical-improvement decision. No_new_numerical_mismatches only detects exact-to-inexact transitions; existing inexact results can worsen. Review all errors and targeted Q/input/inputnorm improvement explicitly.
The CPU reference path never executes the candidate TPU branch. Its unchanged A/B gradients and trajectories cannot validate or falsify candidate TPU improvement.
The earlier BF16 full-Trainer evidence is parent-provided context, not re-audited here, and provides no validation of this separate FP32 hypothesis.
root_gates: Before any hardware: resolve R1/R2 in a new immutable preparation revision, keep old failure evidence, verify changed guards locally, freeze hashes and preserve the new source/design/review in the durable archive. This review grants no launch authorization.

Before any hardware: pin and record the exact Python/JAX/jaxlib/runtime dependency environment alongside source pins; existing proofs record JAX but the bundle does not independently establish complete package/build identity. Confirm correct non-small numerical invocation, single process/four v5p devices, highest precision and exact XLA flags; no inherited data/seed/config change.

For a separately authorized bounded hardware diagnostic: retain every exact source/normal-hidden/loss/scan/full/composed/source-replay/raw-kernel/public-RoPE control, complete physical placement checks, unchanged parameter/batch/common raw/source operands, unchanged named results/native forward hashes, and complete bounded HLO. Any failure is preserved negative evidence and stops attribution without tolerance changes.

Before any full Trainer comparison: independently inspect actual optimized candidate TPU HLO for the scaled-dQ boundary, quantify the common-raw differential, establish targeted actual prefix/inputnorm/Q error reduction and absence of new or worsened unacceptable results. A null benefit stops the sufficient-cause claim. Never infer improvement from validity=true alone.

Only after those separate gates and authorization may a separately pinned full Trainer comparison test the unchanged approved loss-vector criteria. No performance, BF16 integration, replacement/deletion, trajectory or convergence conclusion follows from this review.
